svg.title: One error correction cycle on transmon_surface17
svg.desc: The schedule of one error correction cycle on the drive lines of the 17 qudits, 1024 ns long. 8 CZ steps of 98 ns follow each other, the first from 40 ns and the last from 886 ns; in each step, 3 auxiliary-data pairs wait together, each box naming its partner. Steps 1 to 4 are on the Z auxiliaries and steps 5 to 8 on the X auxiliaries. Between the steps are 52 drive pulses of 40 ns: quarter turns on the auxiliaries around their four steps, quarter turns on the data qudits around the X steps, and an echo on every data qudit in the middle of each half.
